## Adding a program

- [ ] `programs/<id>.bas` — lowercase-kebab-case name
- [ ] `programs/<id>.json` — see [`programs/README.md`](../blob/main/programs/README.md)
- [ ] `fidelity` is the **lowest** value that is true
- [ ] if `corrected`, `notes` lists every change from the source
- [ ] a photo or scan of the source page is **attached to this PR**, not committed

**Source:** <!-- the citation, and where you found the listing -->

**Runs?** <!-- does it run here as-is? If not, what fails? A listing that
does not run yet is still worth archiving as verbatim — say so here. -->
